edits.value_json: 你 means “you,” usually addressing one person. Its visible form combines 亻 with 尔, the standardized simplified form of 爾. 爾/尔 was used for “you/your”; this lexical and graphic connection does not prove that 尔 supplies the sound in 你, whose proposed phonetic analysis remains disputed.
